# Policies
The policies of the Unique Identification Authority of India provide a structured framework for the implementation, management, and governance of the Aadhaar ecosystem. These policies ensure data security, privacy, transparency, and efficient service delivery while defining roles, responsibilities, and compliance standards for all stakeholders. This framework also includes internal policies such as the Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) Policy, Internal Complaints Committee (ICC) Policy, and other administrative and employee welfare policies to promote a safe, inclusive, and accountable work environment.
